name: verter-mcp

tools.name: analyze_css
tools.description: Get CSS analysis for all style blocks: selectors, classes, IDs, specificity, v-bind(), scoped/module flags.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description: Get the full analysis snapshot for a Vue file. Includes imports, bindings, macros, template usage, style analysis.

tools.name: analyze_route_health
tools.description: Cross-reference routes with components to find issues: missing components, dead routes (no links), orphan views, duplicate paths/names.

tools.name: check_component_props
tools.description: Check component props: find unknown props passed to child components and missing required props.

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: check_prop_types
tools.description: Check type compatibility between parent prop values and child prop declarations.

tools.name: compile_file
tools.description: Compile a Vue SFC to JavaScript/CSS. Returns compiled code per virtual node (main, script, template, styles).

tools.name: detect_css_bleed
tools.description: Detect unintended CSS class bleed across components. Finds non-scoped styles that could affect other components, shared class name collisions.

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: detect_migration_targets
tools.description: Detect Options API components that could be migrated to Composition API. Returns candidates with difficulty estimate.

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: detect_prop_drilling
tools.description: Detect prop drilling: props passed through 2+ component levels. Suggests provide/inject migration.

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: explain_vue_api
tools.description: Classify a Vue API function: returns category (lifecycle, reactivity, watcher, DI, etc.) and metadata.

tools.name: find_orphan_components
tools.description: Find orphan components unreachable from any bundler entry point.

tools.name: generate_component_docs
tools.description: Generate Markdown documentation for a Vue component: props table, events, slots, dependencies, styles.

tools.name: generate_tsx
tools.description: Generate TSX type-checking output for a Vue file (same as LSP type-checking path).

strict_slots.description: Enable strict slot type checking (overrides server-level --strict-slots flag)

tools.name: get_bindings
tools.description: Get all top-level bindings with reactivity classification (Ref, Computed, Reactive, etc.).

tools.name: get_component_api
tools.description: Get the public API surface of a Vue component: props, emits, slots, models, expose.

tools.name: get_component_graph
tools.description: Get the component dependency graph. Shows which components import and use which other components.

root.description: Start from a specific file, or omit for full project graph

tools.name: get_component_quality
tools.description: Get a component quality score (0-100) with per-dimension breakdown: a11y, lint, complexity, API surface, CSS, reactivity.

tools.name: get_component_summary
tools.description: Get everything about a component in a single call: API, scores, metrics, diagnostics, CSS, dependencies, dead code. Primary tool for agents — no file reads needed.

tools.name: get_component_types
tools.description: Get inferred/declared types for all props, emits, bindings, and expose in a component.

tools.name: get_framework_surface
tools.description: Resolve a component's framework surfaces (props, emits, slots, options, expose, model) through the framework-surface executor. Returns per-kind support status and members. Routes through the host's single validation-first executor — no second resolver.

tools.name: get_imports
tools.description: Get all imports with Vue API classification (lifecycle, reactivity, watchers, etc.).

tools.name: get_lifecycle_order
tools.description: Get lifecycle hooks in execution order with side effects flagged. Shows which lifecycle stages the component participates in.

tools.name: get_navigation_map
tools.description: Get all navigation links (<RouterLink>/<NuxtLink>) in the project or a specific file. Answers: 'who navigates where?'

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate project statistics: scores, Vue API usage, diagnostics health, component rankings.

tools.name: get_quick_fixes
tools.description: Get available quick fixes and code actions at a byte offset in a Vue file.

offset.description: Byte offset in the SFC source where the cursor is

path.description: File path of the Vue component

tools.name: get_rerender_triggers
tools.description: Get re-render triggers: which reactive bindings cause which template regions to update.

tools.name: get_route_for_component
tools.description: Given a .vue file path, find which route(s) render it. Answers: 'what URL shows this component?'

tools.name: get_route_tree
tools.description: Get the full route tree for the project. Detects vue-router, Nuxt, or unplugin-vue-router. Returns route hierarchy with paths, names, components, guards, layouts, and navigation links.

tools.name: get_router_views
tools.description: Find where <RouterView>/<NuxtPage> components are placed. Answers: 'which components are view containers?'

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: get_side_effects
tools.description: Get all side effects in a component: lifecycle hooks, watchers, provide/inject, DOM queries.

tools.name: get_store_graph
tools.description: Project-wide store dependency graph: components → stores, store → store deps, unused stores.

tools.name: get_store_usage
tools.description: Per-file store usages: which stores are imported, used, destructured, and whether storeToRefs is applied.

path.description: Optional file path. If omitted, checks all loaded files

tools.name: get_template_usage
tools.description: Get template usage analysis: components, binding references, slots, refs, event handlers.

tools.name: get_test_impact
tools.description: Given changed files, identify which test files should be re-run based on the component dependency graph.

tools.name: get_type_errors
tools.description: Get type-level diagnostics for a Vue file: unresolved bindings and type dependencies.

tools.name: lint_file
tools.description: Run lint rules against a Vue file. Returns diagnostics with rule, category, severity, message, and span.

baseline_path.description: Path to a .verter-baseline.json file. When set, only diagnostics NOT in the baseline are returned.

include_evidence.description: Include source evidence snippets (3-line context) around each diagnostic span.

tools.name: lint_project
tools.description: Run lint rules across all loaded files. Returns summary and per-file diagnostics.

baseline_path.description: Path to a .verter-baseline.json file. When set, only diagnostics NOT in the baseline are returned.

errors_only.description: Only return errors, skip warnings and info

include_evidence.description: Include source evidence snippets (3-line context) around each diagnostic span.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all files currently tracked by the analysis host.

tools.name: match_css_selector
tools.description: Test if a CSS selector matches template elements. Returns three-valued result per element: Matches, MaybeMatches, NoMatch.

path.description: File path of the Vue component

selector.description: CSS selector string to test against template elements

tools.name: save_baseline
tools.description: Save a baseline of current diagnostics. Future lint calls with baseline_path will only report NEW issues not in the baseline.

output_path.description: Output path for the baseline file (default: .verter-baseline.json in project root)

preset.description: Lint preset to use when building the baseline

tools.name: scan_project
tools.description: Scan a directory for Vue files and load them into the analysis host. Auto-discovers .verterrc.json / eslint config for lint rules. Returns file count, config status, and any parse errors.

include_deps.description: Also scan .ts/.js files for cross-file analysis

root.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: ssr_migration_plan
tools.description: Analyze a component and return an ordered list of changes needed for SSR safety. Each item includes the issue, its severity, and a suggested fix.

tools.name: ssr_project_report
tools.description: Scan all loaded .vue files and compute per-component SSR readiness scores. Returns a project-wide summary with score distribution, critical-path blockers, and overall SSR adoption readiness.

tools.name: ssr_readiness
tools.description: Score a component's SSR compatibility from 0-100. Checks for client-only lifecycle hooks, DOM queries, browser globals, CSS variable manipulations, and nondeterministic template expressions.

tools.name: suggest_refactorings
tools.description: Detect auto-refactoring opportunities: oversized components, extract component candidates, CSS consolidation.

tools.name: trace_event_flow
tools.description: Trace an event across the component graph: find which components emit it and which listen to it.

tools.name: trace_store_flow
tools.description: Trace a specific store: definition file, all consumers, dependency chain.

store_id.description: Store ID or export name to trace

tools.name: upsert_file
tools.description: Load or update a single file. If source is omitted, reads from disk. Returns change info and diagnostics.

path.description: File path (absolute or relative to project root)

source.description: Inline source content. If omitted, reads from disk

tools.name: validate_provide_inject
tools.description: Validate provide/inject pairs across the project. Finds inject() calls with no matching provide().

instructions: Verter Vue compiler MCP server. Provides deep analysis, diagnostics, compilation, CSS matching, and cross-file analysis for Vue Single File Components. Use scan_project first to load a Vue project, then use get_component_summary for a complete overview of any component, or get_project_stats for project-wide insights. For detailed analysis, use analyze_file, lint_file, get_component_api, etc.
